evidence_type: Assistant transcription of the learner-supplied DBeaver result screenshot; no direct database read.

analysis_window.scope: Units aggregated by product across all 10 source stores and all 3,049 source products, including zero-sales products; the interval is defined by SQL20.

display_normalization: Thousands separators are omitted. Percentage values are represented with four decimal places. Padding trailing zeros preserves displayed numeric values.
ranking_rule: Sum units by item_id across stores; positive units descending, item_id ascending; explicit ROWS cumulative sums.
threshold_rule: Smallest positive-SKU prefix with cumulative_units*100 >= total_units*target; crossing SKU included. TOP and REACH segments overlap and must not be summed.
